markings/cad.note: True size, one unit = one foot. Each drawing opens as one block insert on layer P-PMARK; block geometry is a SOLID hatch with its outline on layer 0, ByBlock. Base point: the middle of an arrow's tail, or the bottom center of a word or symbol (top center for yield line triangles, which sit on the line). Caltrans blocks follow the 2026 Standard Plans; (R) arrows are mirror images, as the plans direct. Stripes are drawn with line types (SSS-STRIPING-PLAN.lin), not blocks. Plan-library blocks are at true size. Green bike crossing dashes (PM-BIKE-XING) repeat every 8 ft along the crossing path (ARRAYPATH). Raised elements are plan outlines at true size.

downloads.label: SSS-PMARK-LIBRARY.dwg
downloads.note: every static marking block in one drawing, one 24 x 36 sheet per group, for the Blocks palette, DesignCenter or a tool palette

downloads.label: SSS-STRIPING-PLAN.lin
downloads.note: striping line types from LA plan sets: lane line, two-way left-turn lane, bike lane, cat track, dotted extension and their remove patterns, in feet

downloads.label: SSS-SIGNAL-PLAN.lin
downloads.note: signal and electrical line types: conduit, remove conduit, remove equipment, substructure, abandon, in feet

downloads.label: SSS-SURVEY-UTILITY.lin
downloads.note: survey and utility line types: painted and plain utility lines, fences, slopes, edge of pavement, in plotted inches

downloads.label: SSS-CAD-TOOLS.lsp
downloads.note: AutoCAD routine SSSDYNEXPORT: copies a drawing's dynamic blocks, cleaned and renamed, into one library DWG with a CSV of their visibility states and other dynamic properties

downloads.label: SSS-STRIPING-PLAN-LIBRARY.dwg
downloads.note: every block from the LA signing and striping plan library in one drawing, grips and visibility states intact

downloads.label: SSS-SIGNAL-PLAN-LIBRARY.dwg
downloads.note: every block from the LA traffic signal plan library in one drawing (signals, arrows, sign posts, site items), grips and visibility states intact
